facts.content: Patient reports mild nausea without vomiting.

facts.content: Patient has no significant past medical history noted.

Patient lives with parents.
Patient drinks alcohol about four times per week, approximately one beer each time.

facts.content: Abdominal pain is assessed as likely of urinary origin with no red-flag features documented at the time of consult.
